items.job: Replace engine short block (piston ring fix)
items.note: Settlement coverage (8 years or 100,000 miles) has expired for most cars.
Free under recall 18V772. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Brake light switch can stop working
items.note: Free under recall 19V149. Check the VIN first.

items.t: CVT automatic can shudder, jerk or stall
items.job: Replace CVT valve body or torque converter
items.note: Subaru warranty extension (10 years or 100,000 miles) has expired; a full CVT replacement costs far more.

items.t: Engine computer can overheat an ignition coil and stall the engine
items.job: Reprogram engine computer and replace ignition coil
items.note: Free under recalls 19V743 and 21V264. Check the VIN first.

items.t: PCV valve can break apart and send pieces into the engine
items.note: Free under recall 19V744 / 19V856. Engine repair is covered if the valve already failed.

items.t: Rear stabilizer bar bracket bolts can work loose
items.job: Replace and torque rear stabilizer bracket bolts
items.note: Free under recall 21V263. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Plug-in hybrid 12-volt charging connection can corrode
items.note: Free under recall 23V080. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Wiring behind the dashboard can rub on a bracket and short out
items.job: Inspect and reroute instrument panel wiring harness
items.note: Free under recall 23V551. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Hybrid fuel cap seal can let fuel spill
items.note: Free under recall 26V106. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Water can get into the gear position switch (recall 23V-755)
items.note: Free under recall 23V-755. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front driveshaft can crack and break (recall 23V-754)
items.note: Free under recall 23V-754. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front ball joint nut can be loose (do-not-drive recall 26V-685)
items.job: Inspect and replace front lower ball joint and nut
items.note: Free under recall 26V-685. Check the VIN first; Subaru says do not drive it.

items.t: Windshield cracks or chips at very low mileage
items.job: Replace windshield and recalibrate the driver-assist camera
items.note: Comprehensive insurance often covers glass; calibration must be done after the swap.
Free under the factory warranty on a car this new.

items.t: Driver's door mirror shakes at highway speed
items.note: Covered by a Subaru service bulletin while in warranty; ask the dealer before paying.
